body:
thanks @meteorcloudy, I'll have a closer look on Monday. 

**Notes for a fix**:
So far it seems that those builds were explicitly requesting `--spawn_strategy=remote` which was by default falling back to a local execution. With a flag flip in order to get the same behaviour we either do not need to specify `--spawn_strategy` at all or make it `--spawn_strategy=remote,local`

@ishikhman Thanks for the notes!
Maybe to be compatible with Bazel 0.25.2, we should use `--spawn_strategy=remote,local` instead of removing the flag?
FYI @philwo 
https://github.com/bazelbuild/continuous-integration/blob/d00107eaef8712316a1521f810c90eeeaba382e6/buildkite/bazelci.py#L1168

Friendly ping :) Our downstream pipeline is red because of this (https://buildkite.com/bazel/bazel-at-head-plus-downstream/builds/987). If you could file issues against those projects with more context that would be great. I can then disable these projects on downstream to get a happy green build while waiting for fixes.

Thank you so much!

Looks like we should fix the flag in [bazelci.py](https://github.com/bazelbuild/continuous-integration/blob/d00107eaef8712316a1521f810c90eeeaba382e6/buildkite/bazelci.py#L1168) instead of from downstream projects. I'll send a fix.
